# MCP tools

<!-- Generated by tools/mcp-docs.py from shell/mcp/caelestia_mcp.py; don't edit by hand. -->

The caelestia MCP server has 29 tools. What they're for, and how to
set it up: [README.md](README.md).

- **See the desktop**: [`screenshot`](#screenshot), [`list_monitors`](#list_monitors), [`list_windows`](#list_windows)
- **Lock**: [`lock_status`](#lock_status), [`lock`](#lock), [`unlock`](#unlock)
- **Wallpaper**: [`wallpaper_list`](#wallpaper_list), [`wallpaper_get`](#wallpaper_get), [`wallpaper_set`](#wallpaper_set), [`wallpaper_clear_monitor`](#wallpaper_clear_monitor)
- **Colours**: [`scheme_get`](#scheme_get), [`scheme_list`](#scheme_list), [`scheme_set`](#scheme_set)
- **Settings**: [`config_get`](#config_get), [`config_set`](#config_set)
- **Desktop**: [`media_status`](#media_status), [`media_control`](#media_control), [`brightness`](#brightness), [`toast`](#toast), [`notifications`](#notifications), [`toggle`](#toggle), [`panel`](#panel)
- **Shortcuts**: [`keybinds`](#keybinds)
- **Emoji**: [`emoji`](#emoji)
- **Window cards**: [`cards`](#cards)
- **Desktop widgets**: [`widgets`](#widgets)
- **Camera**: [`camera`](#camera)
- **Anything else**: [`ipc_list`](#ipc_list), [`ipc_call`](#ipc_call)

## See the desktop

### `screenshot`

Capture a monitor (or all) as an image so you can see the desktop. While the screen is locked this shows the lock screen.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |
| `max_width` | `integer` |  | Downscale to at most this width in pixels (default 1920). |

### `list_monitors`

Monitors with their names, resolution, scale, focused state and active workspace.

No parameters.

### `list_windows`

Open windows (class, title, workspace, monitor, position, size, floating, fullscreen). Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace` | `string` |  | Only this workspace (name or id). |

## Lock

### `lock_status`

Whether the screen is locked.

No parameters.

### `lock`

Lock the screen.

No parameters.

### `unlock`

Unlock the screen without a password. Anyone at the computer can then use it; lock again when done.

No parameters.

## Wallpaper

### `wallpaper_list`

Available wallpapers (images and videos). Use `query` to filter by a case-insensitive substring.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` |  |  |
| `kind` | `any` \| `image` \| `video` |  |  |
| `limit` | `integer` |  | Default 200. |

### `wallpaper_get`

The current wallpaper (image or video path), globally or for one monitor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |

### `wallpaper_set`

Set the wallpaper (image or video). Without `monitor` it applies everywhere, clears per-monitor choices and regenerates the colour scheme; with `monitor` it only changes that monitor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Absolute path, e.g. from wallpaper_list. |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |

### `wallpaper_clear_monitor`

Remove a monitor's own wallpaper so it shows the global one again.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monitor` | `string` | yes | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |

## Colours

### `scheme_get`

The current colour scheme: name, flavour, mode (dark/light) and variant.

No parameters.

### `scheme_list`

Available scheme names, flavours, modes or variants.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `what` | `names` \| `flavours` \| `modes` \| `variants` |  |  |

### `scheme_set`

Change the colour scheme. 'dynamic' follows the wallpaper. Note: a wallpaper hook may force the vibrant variant after wallpaper changes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `flavour` | `string` |  |  |
| `mode` | `dark` \| `light` |  |  |
| `variant` | `string` |  |  |

## Settings

### `config_get`

Read a shell.json setting by dotted key (e.g. 'border.rounding', 'background.desktopClock'). Empty key returns the whole file. Unset keys use the shell's built-in default.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` |  |  |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Read the per-monitor override file instead (monitors/<name>/shell.json). |

### `config_set`

Set a shell.json setting by dotted key; the shell reloads it live. `value` is any JSON value. Creates missing parent objects.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | yes |  |
| `value` | any | yes | New value (string, number, bool, object or array). |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Write the per-monitor override file instead. |

## Desktop

### `media_status`

Media players and the active player's track (title, artist, album, status).

No parameters.

### `media_control`

Control the active media player.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `play` \| `pause` \| `playPause` \| `next` \| `previous` \| `stop` | yes |  |

### `brightness`

Get or set screen brightness (0-1). `value`: '0.5' or '50%' absolute, '+10%' / '+0.1' up, '10%-' / '0.1-' down; omit to read. `monitor` targets one display, else the active one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  |  |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |

### `toast`

Show a toast message in the shell.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `message` | `string` |  |  |
| `kind` | `info` \| `success` \| `warn` \| `error` |  |  |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Material Symbols icon name (default per kind). |

### `notifications`

Do-not-disturb control and clearing notifications.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `status` \| `enableDnd` \| `disableDnd` \| `toggleDnd` \| `clear` | yes |  |

### `toggle`

Turn game mode or the idle inhibitor (keep awake) on/off, or read their state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feature` | `gameMode` \| `idleInhibitor` | yes |  |
| `action` | `status` \| `enable` \| `disable` \| `toggle` | yes |  |

### `panel`

Open/close a shell panel (drawer) such as launcher, dashboard, session, sidebar; or 'settings' to open the settings window. Use action 'list' to see drawer names.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `action` | `toggle` \| `status` \| `list` | yes |  |

## Shortcuts

### `keybinds`

The Hyprland and shell keyboard shortcuts, read from the Hyprland config (what each does, its keys, category). Action 'list' (default) returns them, optionally filtered; 'show'/'hide'/'toggle' the on-screen shortcuts panel; 'settings' opens its settings page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `list` \| `show` \| `hide` \| `toggle` \| `settings` |  |  |
| `query` | `string` |  | Only shortcuts whose title, keys, command or category contain all these words. |
| `owner` | `shell` \| `hyprland` \| `app` |  | Only shortcuts handled by the shell, Hyprland or launching apps. |
| `include_internal` | `boolean` |  | Include pass-through binds the shell uses itself. |

## Emoji

### `emoji`

The emoji picker (Ctrl+Super+Space). 'search' finds emoji by name or keyword; 'type' types text (an emoji) into the focused window; 'show', 'hide' and 'toggle' the picker.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `search` \| `type` \| `show` \| `hide` \| `toggle` | yes |  |
| `query` | `string` |  | Words to search for, for 'search'. |
| `text` | `string` |  | What to type, for 'type'. |

## Window cards

### `cards`

Window cards: two windows paired into one Hyprland group that flips over in 3D to show the other. 'list' shows the cards; 'pair' pairs two windows by address (see list_windows / hyprctl clients), front first; 'pick' starts interactive pairing for the focused window; 'flip' and 'unpair' act on the focused card.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `list` \| `pair` \| `pick` \| `flip` \| `unpair` | yes |  |
| `front` | `string` |  | Address (0x...) of the window shown first, for 'pair'. |
| `back` | `string` |  | Address (0x...) of the window on the back, for 'pair'. |

## Desktop widgets

### `widgets`

Desktop widgets (widget plugins). 'list' shows installed plugins and placed widgets; 'add' places one (type = plugin id, monitor = e.g. DP-1); 'place' moves/resizes one (screen logical px); 'configure' sets its settings (JSON object, e.g. {"style": "almond"} for eyes); 'remove'; 'edit'/'done' open/close the on-screen editor; 'rescan' re-reads the plugin folders.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `list` \| `add` \| `place` \| `configure` \| `remove` \| `edit` \| `done` \| `rescan` | yes |  |
| `type` | `string` |  | Plugin id, for 'add'. |
| `monitor` | `string` |  | Monitor name, e.g. DP-1 (see list_monitors). |
| `uid` | `string` |  | Placed widget id (from 'list'). |
| `x` | `integer` |  |  |
| `y` | `integer` |  |  |
| `width` | `integer` |  |  |
| `height` | `integer` |  |  |
| `settings` | `object` |  | For 'configure': replaces the widget's settings. |

## Camera

### `camera`

The webcam (caelestia-camerad): 'status' (who's using it, gestures state, last light/presence readings), 'controls' (zoom, focus, white balance, ...), 'set' a control, 'presets' / 'apply' a saved preset, 'gestures' on/off, 'panel' to open the camera panel. Photos are deliberately not available here.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `status` \| `controls` \| `set` \| `presets` \| `apply` \| `gestures` \| `panel` | yes |  |
| `key` | `string` |  | Control key for 'set', e.g. zoom_absolute (see 'controls'). |
| `value` | any |  | Value for 'set' (number or boolean). |
| `name` | `string` |  | Preset name for 'apply'. |
| `on` | `boolean` |  | For 'gestures': true or false; leave out to toggle. |

## Anything else

### `ipc_list`

Every IPC target and function the running shell exposes (for ipc_call).

No parameters.

### `ipc_call`

Call any shell IPC function directly (see ipc_list), e.g. target 'picker' function 'openClip'.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` | yes |  |
| `function` | `string` | yes |  |
| `args` | `array` |  |  |
